spis.name: Operating System Support
spis.description: Operating systems must not be out of vendor support.
spis.successMeasure: 100% of applicable servers/workstations run vendor-supported OS versions.
spis.recommendedAction: Upgrade or migrate affected operating systems to vendor-supported versions and add lifecycle governance checkpoints.

spis.name: Operating System N-2
spis.description: Operating systems must be N-2 or better.
spis.successMeasure: 100% of applicable servers/workstations are N-2 or better.
spis.recommendedAction: Plan staged OS major-version uplift to reach N-2 or better across impacted hosts.

spis.name: Server Critical Vulnerability
spis.description: Servers must not have Critical vulnerabilities.
spis.recommendedAction: Patch or mitigate critical server vulnerabilities immediately and confirm exploitability posture.

spis.name: Production Server High Risk (Critical + Unsupported OS)
spis.description: High Risk: Production servers must not have Critical vulns with out-of-support OS.
spis.successMeasure: 0 production servers with critical vulnerabilities on unsupported OS.
spis.recommendedAction: Treat as immediate operational risk: isolate or patch production server, remove critical vuln, and uplift unsupported OS.

spis.name: Production Server High Risk (Critical + Unsupported Software)
spis.description: High Risk: Production servers must not have Critical vulns with out-of-support installed software.
spis.successMeasure: 0 production servers with critical vulnerabilities plus unsupported installed software.
spis.recommendedAction: Prioritize production server software remediation: update unsupported software and clear linked critical vulnerabilities.

spis.name: Production Workstation High Risk (Critical + Unsupported Software)
spis.description: High Risk: Production-supporting workstations must not have Critical vulns with out-of-support installed software.
spis.successMeasure: 0 production-supporting workstations with critical vulnerabilities plus unsupported installed software.
spis.recommendedAction: Prioritize production-support workstation software remediation: update unsupported software and clear linked critical vulnerabilities.

spis.name: Network Device Critical Vulnerability
spis.description: Network devices must not have Critical vulnerabilities.
spis.recommendedAction: Patch or mitigate critical network-device vulnerabilities and validate rule/ACL hardening.

spis.name: Network Device Support
spis.description: Network devices must not have unsupported OS/firmware.
spis.successMeasure: 100% of network-device OS/firmware versions are supported.
spis.recommendedAction: Upgrade device firmware/OS to supported releases and align with approved baseline catalog.

spis.name: Network Device Patch Currency
spis.description: Network devices must be on latest patches.
spis.successMeasure: 100% of network devices on latest patch level.
spis.recommendedAction: Bring network devices to latest patch level and enforce maintenance windows with SLA tracking.

spis.name: Asset Lifecycle Currency
spis.description: No physical device should be EOL or out of warranty.
spis.successMeasure: 0 physical devices in EOL or out-of-warranty state.
spis.recommendedAction: Replace or renew lifecycle-expired assets (EOL / out-of-warranty) through prioritized capital plan.
